source_refs.title: Send attachments with your Gmail message - Computer - Gmail Help
source_refs.applicability: Gmail in a web browser on a computer; size limits and storage conditions as stated on the page
source_refs.verified_excerpt: For personal Gmail accounts, the limit is 25 MB.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On a computer: Open Gmail in a web browser. Select 'Compose' to start a new message. At the bottom of the compose window, select the 'Attach' icon. Choose the files you want to send. Confirm your selection with the 'Open' button. If the total attachment size exceeds the limit, Gmail removes the attachment and adds it to the email as a Google Drive link. Gmail blocks executable files, such as .exe files, to prevent viruses. Attachments count toward your Google storage. If you reach your storage limit, you can't send or receive attachments.
